rubric.High: The customer is blocked from doing something important, data or account security is at risk, many people are affected, or support has already failed to respond. Needs a human now.
rubric.Medium: A real defect that impedes normal use, but the customer can keep working or has a workaround. Needs a fix, not an interrupt.
rubric.Low: Nothing is broken: a question, a request, praise, or a problem the customer has already resolved.

note: Labels are the triage a support lead would apply, assigned independently of what the scorer currently outputs. Cases the scorer gets wrong are kept in the set, not relabelled.
